title: I cut in the middle of a thought
text: I cut in the middle of a thought, sometimes in the middle of a word (the engine splits Thai words). Gate: `python -m cutdeck.hks_cut_check --prproj <day> --sequence <draft> --from <body start>` reads the audio and lists every cut in speech the viewer can see; fix each one or say why it stays.
